examples.english: Thousands of people are fleeing the bombing in the city.
examples.persian: هزاران نفر در حال فرار از بمباران شهر هستند.

miniContext: Thousands of people are fleeing the bombing in the city.

examples.english: Many refugees have crossed the border to escape the war.
examples.persian: بسیاری از پناهندگان برای فرار از جنگ از مرز عبور کرده‌اند.

miniContext: Many refugees have crossed the border to escape the war.

examples.english: The men had to take refuge in the French embassy.
examples.persian: آن مردان مجبور شدند در سفارت فرانسه پناه بگیرند.

miniContext: The men had to take refuge in the French embassy.

examples.english: The numbers seeking asylum have increased recently.
examples.persian: تعداد کسانی که درخواست پناهندگی می‌کنند اخیراً افزایش یافته است.

miniContext: The numbers seeking asylum have increased recently.

examples.english: An ethnic community kept many of its old traditions alive.
examples.persian: یک جامعه‌ی قومی بسیاری از سنت‌های قدیمی خود را زنده نگه داشت.

miniContext: An ethnic community kept many of its old traditions alive.

examples.english: Ethnic minorities make up 10% of the town's population.
examples.persian: اقلیت‌های قومی ۱۰ درصد از جمعیت شهر را تشکیل می‌دهند.

miniContext: Ethnic minorities make up 10% of the town's population.

examples.english: There has been a lot of racial tension between different ethnic groups.
examples.persian: بین گروه‌های قومی مختلف تنش نژادی زیادی وجود داشته است.

miniContext: There has been a lot of racial tension between different ethnic groups.

examples.english: She was a victim of racial discrimination at work.
examples.persian: او قربانی تبعیض نژادی در محل کار شد.

miniContext: She was a victim of racial discrimination at work.

examples.english: Their decision was based on prejudice and a complete lack of understanding.
examples.persian: تصمیم آن‌ها بر پایه‌ی تعصب و نبودِ کامل درک بود.

miniContext: Their decision was based on prejudice and a complete lack of understanding.

examples.english: Moving away from my native country was a huge culture shock.
examples.persian: دور شدن از کشور زادگاهم شوک فرهنگی بزرگی بود.

miniContext: Moving away from my native country was a huge culture shock.

examples.english: Culture shock is the confusion and anxiety you feel when you first live in another country.
examples.persian: شوک فرهنگی سردرگمی و اضطرابی است که هنگام زندگی اولیه در کشوری دیگر حس می‌کنید.

miniContext: Culture shock is the confusion and anxiety you feel when you first live in another country.

examples.english: People have never been hostile towards me — quite the opposite.
examples.persian: مردم هرگز نسبت به من خصومتی نشان نداده‌اند، کاملاً برعکس.

miniContext: People have never been hostile towards me — quite the opposite.

examples.english: People have accepted me for what I am, including my religious faith.
examples.persian: مردم مرا همان‌طور که هستم پذیرفته‌اند، از جمله ایمان مذهبی‌ام.

miniContext: People have accepted me for what I am, including my religious faith.

examples.english: They've seen beyond the stereotype and got to know who I really am.
examples.persian: آن‌ها فراتر از کلیشه را دیدند و فهمیدند من واقعاً چه کسی هستم.

miniContext: They've seen beyond the stereotype and got to know who I really am.

examples.english: I recognize the need for integration in order to live in peace with my neighbours.
examples.persian: من نیاز به ادغام در جامعه را برای زندگی مسالمت‌آمیز با همسایگانم درک می‌کنم.

miniContext: I recognize the need for integration in order to live in peace with my neighbours.

examples.english: People here just want to live in peace with each other.
examples.persian: مردم اینجا فقط می‌خواهند با هم در صلح زندگی کنند.

miniContext: People here just want to live in peace with each other.

examples.english: I still have feelings of nostalgia for my country of origin.
examples.persian: هنوز هم دلتنگی نسبت به کشور اصلی‌ام را احساس می‌کنم.

miniContext: I still have feelings of nostalgia for my country of origin.

examples.english: A person's country of origin is where they were born.
examples.persian: کشور مبدأ فردی همان جایی است که او در آن به دنیا آمده است.

miniContext: A person's country of origin is where they were born.

examples.english: I have no desire to go back.

miniContext: I have no desire to go back.
